title: Case archive at 1.0 mm (4 cases, ~34 MB) in real Chrome after PR 82 (bridge long-poll)

environment.base: worktree p-d merged origin/main including PR 82
environment.browser: real Chrome (Claude in Chrome), own tab, vite dev on 127.0.0.1:5174, stdio connector plus file-IPC driver (about 20 ms driver polling)
environment.foreground: The tab could not be made the selected tab of its window with the available tools (tabs_context reported another tab selected), but document.visibilityState was "visible" in the page throughout.
environment.load: Other agents were reported idle; no heavy local processes were started by me during measurement. Machine load was not otherwise measured. The page JS heap reached about 1.4 GB after holding 4-7 large cases.
environment.localNetworkAccessPrompt: No Local Network Access prompt appeared or blocked the page (the connector connected and all commands worked)
environment.connectionLimitStalls: None observed as a distinct failure; the stalls seen were page-side busy time, not request queuing (not instrumented at network level)

previous.smallRoundTrip7Chunks: about 7 s read and 7 s write

idlePollRate.note: one parked /poll request at a time, re-issued at once after each response; measured with the Resource Timing API over a 10 s idle window after connecting

import1.commit: timed out at the 15 s command limit; the import was NOT applied (case list stayed empty)

largeRun4Cases.fifthAndSixthSave: not cleanly measured: after the second import the page was heavily loaded; two caseSave calls hit the 15 s timeout (15.2 s and 15.5 s) with listMs of 14-19 s, and a later clean 1..6 series (remove all, then save six) did not complete within about 15 minutes (page JS heap about 1.4 GB, case removal/list extremely slow). Treat the 5th/6th save as NOT passing the 15 s limit on this run.

comparison: Export read 26.5 s vs 519 s (19.6x faster); per-chunk about 49 ms vs about 1000 ms, flat across quarters (49.0, 51.0, 54.2, 49.4 ms). Import write 26.6 s vs 518 s (19.5x faster), flat (about 50 ms per chunk). Small 2-case round trip 0.35 s read + 0.41 s write + 0.16 s commit vs about 7 s + 7 s. The bottleneck moved from the poll interval to page work: commit of the 34 MB archive takes about 9-15 s and sometimes exceeded the 15 s command timeout (first import), case saves/listing remain slow as cases accumulate (4th save 10.7 s, 5th/6th over 15 s), so the per-command timeout margin is now limited by caseSave/commit, not transfer chunks.

checks.detail: 7 chunks each way, 0.35 s read and 0.41 s write, hashes and revisions equal
first import: writes fine but commit timed out and nothing was restored; second import: commit 9.2 s, archive revision and all 4 case revisions equal the originals
10 /poll requests in 10 s idle, each parked about 1.01 s

No poll-related console errors. One uncaught exception "Error: La" (minified, from a worker/eval path) was logged at 16:52, during the slow, memory-heavy phase; its relation to the connector is unknown

after stopping the connector the page state showed "Cannot reach the local connector..." with Connect re-enabled and Disconnect disabled; no page error or hang. Whether polls fully stopped was not counted (the Resource Timing buffer was full).
5th/6th save over the 15 s command timeout and page extremely slow with 5-7 large cases

notVerified: Cause of the memory growth and slowness with many large cases (page heap about 1.4 GB)
Cause of the 34 MB commit sometimes exceeding 15 s (9.2 s on the retry, over 15 s the first time)
Poll count after disconnect; connection-limit stalls at network level
Selected/foreground tab state beyond visibilityState being visible
Run-to-run variance of the transfer times (one read, two import writes)
The meaning of the "Error: La" exception
